newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products firmer except fuel oil barges.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products firmer except fuel oil barges.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly firmer on Wednesday, traders said.
Gasoline barges rose $2.0 as higher NYMEX futures and tighter barge material offset a closed arb to U.S.
Naphtha rose after an Egyptian Alex cargo traded at $186.75 cif basis Rotterdam, nearly $3 above the last trade on Tuesday.
Gas oil was firm after IPE futures strengthened. Heating oil barges were active with storage material trading at IPE June +50 cents fob AR for balance of month delivery.
High sulphur fuel oil barges fell slightly as bunker demand thinned, trading thrice in the afternoon at $85 a tonne.
High sulphur cargoes were talked higher, with two offers heard at 479 and $82 fob, but buyers were still a bay.
